key_insight: DEScover uses four LLM agents to discover physically interpretable DES subgrid length scales from the idea of measuring grid width normal to the local vortex axis.
engineering_relevance: The framework could accelerate turbulence-model development while reducing reliance on manual expert formulation.
method: Infer local vortex axes using different vortex-identification methods.
Use four agents to propose, review, implement, and evaluate candidate length scales.
Generate CFD simulation scripts to test candidate formulations.
evidence_signal: Across a flat plate, backward-facing step, free shear layer, and iced airfoil, the best candidate consistently outperformed the maximum-cell-size baseline and matched or slightly exceeded an expert-designed shear-layer-adapted scale.
watch_item: The reported average discovery time of about 25 minutes excludes CFD simulations, and broader generalization beyond the four test cases remains unestablished.
paper_title: Automated Discovery of Physically Interpretable Subgrid Length Scales for Detached Eddy Simulation via Agentic AI
